changes: Auto Review: reviews run on the chosen accounts in order (primary, then Codex fallbacks), and no other; the page lists every review CPA served with each account's place in the chain

Accounts: Codex cards show manual resets and the plan renewal with Reset quota, as CPA's panel does; quota as bar rows; credits 0 when none; each card shows 24 h / 7 d use with cache-hit tokens, cache rate and cost; All / Enabled / Disabled / Hold filter kept across restarts

Fallbacks lists every API key and provider in CPA with its use and credits (DeepSeek balance, OpenRouter key budget); Providers > In CPA lists every provider; Auto Review keeps and lists its recent reviews across config reloads

A key that answers that it has no credits (OpenAI insufficient_quota / credit_balance_exhausted, Anthropic, DeepSeek, HTTP 402) is left out of routing for 30 min, doubling to 12 h, and CPA's own selector is told to skip it; a request that succeeds on it, or Credits added, puts it back

For a model sign-in accounts serve, API keys and other providers are fallbacks the user turns on under Accounts > Fallbacks, used only after every sign-in account is spent; the usage log no longer keeps a configured key as a record's source

Smart routing covers Codex, Claude and Antigravity sign-in accounts and mixed requests (0.8.0): accounts with quota left come first, then unread sign-in accounts; a spent account is never chosen while another can answer
